noveltyJustification: This iteration confirms the shipped tooltip geometry and dimming while isolating mixed-mark indicator semantics and density-earned cursor guides as the interaction-specific opportunities.
keyQuestions: Which tooltip, legend and interaction patterns improve reading without adding decoration?
answeredQuestions: Keep the shipped tooltip geometry, table fallback, below-plot legend and reversible dimming. Add per-series tooltip indicator shapes, permit data-backed contextual totals, and earn cursor guides only for dense multi-series forms.
ruledOut: Global tooltip padding, radius, shadow or width restyle.
Moving every legend above or beside the plot.
A permanent cursor guide on every form.
Treating legend click and legend hover as the same state without an explicit contract decision.

title: Shipped tooltip geometry is contract-strong
summary: The HTML card is bounded, palette-driven, positioned against the mark, initialized empty and wired to the same readout values as the table.

title: Contextual headers and totals should be optional
summary: Formatter, unit and total rows help when the data contract supplies them, but should not become decorative tooltip chrome.

title: Mixed mark types need truthful tooltip indicators
summary: The shared square indicator hides the composed chart's line-versus-column distinction that the legend already carries.

title: Dimming and pointer reach are reversible and bounded
summary: 0.3 non-selected opacity, empty initial state, latch reset, keyboard controls and REACH 36 support comparison without changing the settled picture.

title: Below-plot legend placement is the correct small-card default
summary: The current below-plot 16px-gap row matches compact area references, while Carbon's side legend and panel serve larger compositions.

title: Cursor guides should be earned by dense multi-series forms
summary: A guide or active marker can anchor a crowded x position, but the default tooltip remains legible without a permanent guide.

direction: Global tooltip padding, radius, shadow or width restyle.
reason: The current 128px floor, 6px by 10px padding, bounded placement and table-backed readout already satisfy the interaction contract.
The icon reference is a specialized label treatment and the current swatch or rule can carry series identity with less visual noise.

direction: Moving every legend above or beside the plot.
reason: The contract and Mantine compact examples support below-plot legends, while Carbon's alternate positions belong to larger compositions.

direction: A permanent cursor guide on every form.
reason: Shadcn's default tooltip works without a guide, and a guide only earns its space when x-position ambiguity is demonstrated.

direction: Treating legend click and legend hover as the same state without an explicit contract decision.
reason: The current code wires legend click and keyboard latch but no pointerenter or pointerleave preview, so the two states are observably different.
